generations.name: Launch (German-built)
generations.notes: Launch on MEB: 82 kWh gross (77 kWh usable) pack, DC 125 kW (raised to 135 kW by software update); APP310 motor; built in Zwickau/Emden. The 125 to 135 kW OTA raise changes curves within this entry. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volkswagen_ID.4

generations.name: 2023 US-built
generations.notes: Chattanooga production. New 62 kWh Standard pack (SK On, 140 kW). 82 kWh RWD cars get an SK On (170 kW) or LG (135 kW) pack; all AWD get SK On. Two 82 kWh pack suppliers with different DC peaks in one model year; the data may need a per-supplier variant. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volkswagen_ID.4

generations.name: 2024 update
generations.notes: APP550 motor, new software, bigger screen; the 82 kWh pack peaks at 175 kW (10-80% in about 28 min). 62 kWh Standard sidelined in 2025 and dropped by 2026. last_year 2026 (US). No Canada-specific end date found, but Canadian ID.4s came from Chattanooga, so the same end is likely. NACS was not confirmed on any fetched page. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volkswagen_ID.4 ; https://insideevs.com/news/792524/volkswagen-id4-dead/ ; https://www.carscoops.com/2026/04/vw-id4-chattanooga-production-end/
